# PhysxParticleAPI (particle object base)

Base API of a particle object, applied automatically by [USD](glossary.md#usd) with PhysxParticleSetAPI. The parser never checks it: its columns are read on every [prim](glossary.md#prim) that lists PhysxParticleSetAPI, and its presence only steers property changes, where a [PointInstancer](glossary.md#pointinstancer) that lists it is not handled as a rigid-body instancer.

- **Applies to:** [`PointBased`](glossary.md#pointbased), `PointInstancer`
- **Requires on the same prim:** [`PhysxParticleSetAPI`](PhysxParticleSetAPI.md)
- **No [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns) gate:** the consumer reads these columns whenever they exist on the prim, applied or not. The builders do not expose this API.
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the USD schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxParticle:particleSystem` | uint64 array, RELATIONSHIP_PATH_ID |  |  | not written |  | The set has no particle system: the runtime logs '[PhysX](glossary.md#physx) Particles at <path> are missing a valid simulation-owner particle system and will not be simulated.' and creates nothing. Only the first target is used. |
| `physxParticle:particleEnabled` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | true | true. With false the set is created but its particle buffer is not added to the particle system. |
| `physxParticle:selfCollision` | bool8 | none | true | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | false **diverges** | false: the set's particle phase lacks the PhysX self-collide flag, so its particles do not interact with particles of the same group. USD's fallback is true, so write the value. |
| `physxParticle:particleGroup` | int32 | none | 0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0 | Group 0. The group selects the PhysX phase of the set's particles; the runtime creates one phase per group and particle system, with the system's PBD material. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxParticleSetAPI`](PhysxParticleSetAPI.md):** The columns are read in the particle-set parse, which is gated on PhysxParticleSetAPI alone; USD lists this API automatically with it.
- **[`PointInstancer`](PointInstancer.md):** Live edits of positions, orientations, velocities, angularVelocities, protoIndices and ids on a PointInstancer are handled as rigid-body instancer changes only when the instancer does not list this API; a protoIndices or ids edit there is a structural change. A populator that lists PhysxParticleSetAPI on a PointInstancer should therefore list this API too, as USD applies it automatically with PhysxParticleSetAPI.
